 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India has improved its ranking to 38th place in the Global Innovation Index (GII) 2025, up from its 2020 position of 48th.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s ranking in the GII 2025 is 38th, showcasing its growing innovation performance globally.**
 
• **India is ranked #1 among lower-middle-income economies and in the Central and Southern Asia region.**
 
• **India has improved in specific sub-categories such as knowledge and technology outputs, where it ranks 22nd.**
 
• **India continues to perform well in research, innovation ecosystems, and technology-driven growth.**
 
• Top Countries: Switzerland, Sweden, United States of America.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Global Innovation Index (GII) 2025__

 __
 
• The GII assesses 139 countries using over 80 indicators, categorizing them into seven pillars to evaluate their innovation capabilities.
 
• The index includes indicators like human capital, infrastructure, market sophistication, and knowledge outputs.
 
 
 
• Switzerland__
 __
 
• Ranked #1 in the Global Innovation Index 2025 with a score of 66, leading global innovation performance.
 
 
 
• India’s Strengths and Weaknesses__
 
 
• Strengths: India ranks high in knowledge and technology outputs and human capital & research.
 
• Weaknesses: India faces challenges in areas such as business sophistication, infrastructure, and institutions.
